title: Chameleon dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- tail curling behind -->
  <path d="M78 72 Q90 68 88 56 Q86 46 78 48 Q72 50 74 56 Q76 60 80 58" fill="none" stroke="#3ddc84" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- back leg -->
  <path d="M60 68 L58 82 L52 86" stroke="#2bb86a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="87" r="4" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="60" rx="24" ry="16" fill="#3ddc84" transform="rotate(-10 52 60)"/>
  <!-- belly stripe -->
  <ellipse cx="52" cy="66" rx="16" ry="7" fill="#a8f5c4" transform="rotate(-10 52 66)"/>
  <!-- front arm raised dancing -->
  <path d="M38 54 Q28 42 22 38" stroke="#2bb86a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="20" cy="36" r="4" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <!-- other front arm down -->
  <path d="M36 62 Q28 68 26 74" stroke="#2bb86a" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
  <circle cx="25" cy="76" r="4" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="42" rx="16" ry="13" fill="#48f592" transform="rotate(-15 34 42)"/>
  <!-- casque crest -->
  <path d="M28 32 Q32 22 40 30 Q38 28 34 34 Z" fill="#7dffb8"/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="40" r="6" fill="#f5f5f5"/>
  <circle cx="27" cy="40" r="3" fill="#1a5c34"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="39" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smiling mouth -->
  <path d="M20 48 Q26 54 34 50" stroke="#1a5c34" stroke-width="1.8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tongue flicking out happily -->
  <path d="M19 47 Q10 44 6 46 Q10 48 18 49" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <!-- spots for cuteness -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="3" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="58" r="2.5" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="66" r="2" fill="#1fa856"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="68" r="2.5" fill="#a8f5c4"/>
  <!-- dance motion lines -->
  <path d="M70 36 Q74 32 78 36" stroke="#ffd93d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M66 28 Q72 22 80 28" stroke="#ffd93d" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="20" r="2.5" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="24" r="2" fill="#ffd93d"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="40" r="1.8" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
</svg>
